dashboard.delete_folder_message: Delete “{name}”? Its designs and subfolders move up one level; nothing is deleted.
dashboard.cannot_move_folder_into_itself: A folder cannot be moved into itself.
dashboard.move_n_designs_to_trash: Move {n} designs to the trash? You can restore them later.
dashboard.could_not_delete_n: {n} designs could not be moved to the trash.
dashboard.folder_is_empty: This folder is empty. Drag designs here or create one.
dashboard.no_designs_outside_folders: Every design is in a folder.
editor.pdf_print_vector_desc: Sharp at any size: shapes and text as vectors, images at full resolution, exact print size {w} × {h} mm.
editor.pdf_flattened_image_desc: Each page as one picture at the size chosen below. For viewers that mishandle vector files.
dashboard.import_stopped: Import stopped. Run it again to continue; finished designs are skipped.
dashboard.drop_to_import_here: Drop files or folders to import into {folder}
dashboard.import_files_hint: Import .pptx (e.g. Canva exports), .odp, .md or .hyc files into this folder
dashboard.import_folder_hint: Import a whole folder; its sub-folders become folders here
editor.vectorize_tooltip: Trace this image into sharp, editable vector shapes
editor.vectorize_hint: Works best on logos, icons and flat illustrations. The image is replaced by a group of vector shapes, one per color; undo brings the image back.
editor.vectorize_svg_exact: This image is an SVG: its shapes are taken over exactly, nothing is traced.
editor.vectorize_photo_warning: This looks like a photo or a soft gradient. Tracing it gives many shapes and loses the look; keep it as an image instead.
editor.enhance_hint: Sharpens small or blurry artwork with AI first, for rounder details and cleaner thin lines. Runs in your browser.
editor.enhance_unavailable: Enhance could not run in this browser, so the image was traced without it.
editor.enhance_not_needed: This image has enough pixels of its own, so Enhance was not needed.
dashboard.print_profiles_hint: CMYK colour profiles for print exports (CMYK TIFF, EPS). Exports convert to CMYK through the chosen profile and embed it, so the print shop knows exactly what the file was made for.
editor.tiff_desc: Print-ready image in CMYK or RGB with the colour profile embedded
editor.intent_relative: Relative colorimetric (exact in-gamut colours, brand colours)
editor.intent_perceptual: Perceptual (smooth for photos with vivid colours)
editor.black_ink_only_desc: Pure black prints as 100% K instead of a four-colour mix, so small text stays sharp even if the plates are slightly misaligned.
errors.print_profile_missing: Choose a colour profile for the CMYK export.
editor.make_editable_tooltip: Turn this SVG into shapes so colours and parts can be edited
